questions.question: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
questions.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) >= '2012'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

questions.question: Provide the IDs and age of the client with high level credit card, which is eligible for loans.
questions.evidence: the credit card is high-level refers to card.type = 'gold'; eligible for loans refers to disp.type = 'OWNER'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.client_id, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T3.birth_date) FROM disp AS T1 INNER JOIN card AS T2 ON T2.disp_id = T1.disp_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'gold' AND T1.type = 'OWNER'
questions.pred_sql: SELECT c.client_id, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM client AS c INNER JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id INNER JOIN card AS ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
